sections: Open a skill below for approximate base odds per eligible action with the matching map. The May 15 developer update gives a 2× chance at skill level 70 and 3× at level 85. Divide the listed denominator by two or three to estimate the boosted chance. These bonuses apply to mapped skilling pets.
The Microscape Scribe lists odds that vary by task. A second fan database reports lower flat skilling rates. The exact base rates still need in-game confirmation.
Visit Mork or Otis at Fellroot Swamp Hut and buy the map for the pet you want. Carry that map while training or fighting. The map is consumed when you find its pet.
